about: Titrators (potentiometric, Karl Fischer coulometric, Kjeldahl distillation-titration): titrant, method KEY=VALUE, sample, stir, connect, start (job), stop, curve, result, status. Ranges and units come from each member's contract.

secondary_not_mapped.malvern_microcalpeaq: isothermal titration calorimetry: injections into a calorimeter cell with heat as the signal; its primary class (bioassay) owns the instrument and can reuse these handlers

membership.notes: power comes from the shared layer; the UDK 159 door and fault acknowledge too (open / close door, ack).

titrant.label: no titration running
titrant.message: {inst} is titrating; the titrant cannot change now.
titrant.fix: wait for the titration (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it.

titrant.label: nothing dosed yet
titrant.message: {inst} has already dosed titrant into this sample; the titrant and the cylinder stay as they are until the next sample.
titrant.fix: ask the lab operator for a new sample, then declare the titrant.

method.label: no titration running
method.message: {inst} is titrating; the method cannot change now.
method.fix: wait for the titration (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it.

connect.label: no titration running
connect.fix: wait for the titration (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it.

stir-off.label: no titration running
stir-off.message: {inst} is titrating; the stirrer must keep running.
stir-off.fix: wait for the titration (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it first.

start.label: power on
start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.label: electrode connected
start.message: no electrode is connected to {inst}.
start.fix: connect it: `chemlab run {inst} connect electrode=ELECTRODE_ID` (the id the lab gave you).

start.label: titration cell connected
start.message: no titration cell (beaker) is registered on {inst}.
start.fix: connect it: `chemlab run {inst} connect cell=BEAKER_ID`.

start.label: dosing cylinder chosen
start.message: {inst} has no dosing cylinder chosen.
start.fix: declare the titrant with its cylinder: `chemlab run {inst} titrant 0.1M --cylinder 20mL`.

start.label: titrant declared
start.message: {inst} has no titrant concentration.
start.fix: declare it: `chemlab run {inst} titrant 0.1M`.

start.label: method set
start.message: {inst} has no titration method.
start.fix: set one: `chemlab run {inst} method mode=dynamic increment=0.1mL max=15mL`.

start.label: stability rule set
start.message: {inst} has no stability rule (hold time and tolerance).
start.fix: set it: `chemlab run {inst} method hold=0.5s tolerance=1mV`.

start.label: dosing rate set
start.message: {inst} has no dosing rate.
start.fix: set it: `chemlab run {inst} method rate=30mL/min`.

start.label: stirring
start.message: the stirrer of {inst} is off; it titrates only while stirring.
start.fix: stir: `chemlab run {inst} stir 300rpm`.

start.label: fresh sample
start.message: {inst} has already titrated this sample.
start.fix: ask the lab operator for a new sample.

stop.label: a titration running
stop.fix: nothing to stop; see `chemlab run {inst} status`.

titration.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} has no sample in the titration cell (the lab places it), or a setting is missing.
titration.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: ask the lab operator for the sample; check `chemlab run {inst} status`.

titration.configure_method:PRECONDITION_.message: {inst} takes the dose increment and the maximum volume only as whole steps of its dosing cylinder (choose the cylinder first), not more than the cylinder holds, and an end-point potential only in endpoint mode.
titration.configure_method:PRECONDITION_.fix: declare the cylinder (`chemlab run {inst} titrant 0.1M --cylinder 20mL`) and give volumes in whole cylinder steps.

titration.calculate_content:PRECONDITION.message: {inst} has no end point to compute a content from.
titration.calculate_content:PRECONDITION.fix: run the titration to its end first.

unsupported.sample: the sample volume is given to the result calculation

alternatives.sample: `chemlab run INST result --sample 25mL` after the titration.

titrant: the titrant concentration is in mol/L (M); --cylinder is the exchange unit volume 5, 10, 20 or 50 mL
method: mode=endpoint titrates to ep (a potential); mode=dynamic finds the equivalence point (ep is then not used)
increment and max must be whole steps of the cylinder (20 mL cylinder: 0.2 µL steps)
result: with --sample V (and --ratio R) it computes the content = end-point volume x titrant concentration x R / V

metrohm_omnis.manual: OMNIS titrator product manual (titration system p.17-35, stirrer and dosing unit p.36-38)

examples.method: chemlab run INST method mode=dynamic increment=0.1mL max=15mL hold=0.5s tolerance=0V rate=30mL/min
examples.connect: chemlab run INST connect electrode=electrode_01 cell=beaker_01

method.label: no determination running
method.message: {inst} is titrating; the method cannot change now.
method.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it.

sample.label: no determination running
sample.message: {inst} is titrating; give the sample size before the start.
sample.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it.

stir.label: power on
stir.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.label: power on
start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.label: titration cell installed
start.message: the titration cell of {inst} is not installed.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to assemble the cell and electrodes.

start.label: generator electrode installed
start.message: the generator electrode of {inst} is not installed.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to assemble the cell and electrodes.

start.label: indicator electrode installed
start.message: the indicator electrode of {inst} is not installed.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to assemble the cell and electrodes.

start.label: reagent ready
start.message: the KF reagent of {inst} is not ready.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to fill fresh reagent.

start.label: a sample added
start.message: no sample has been added to the cell of {inst}.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to add the sample.

start.label: end-point hold set
start.message: {inst} has no end-point hold time in its method.
start.fix: set it: `chemlab run {inst} method hold=1s`.

start.label: drift compensation set
start.message: {inst} has no drift compensation in its method.
start.fix: set it: `chemlab run {inst} method drift-comp=0ug/min` (or the measured drift).

stop.label: a determination running
stop.fix: nothing to stop; see `chemlab run {inst} status`.

coulometry.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} cannot start: the drift is above the start-drift threshold, or this sample was already titrated.
coulometry.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: check the drift (`chemlab run {inst} status`); raise `method start-drift=...` only if the method allows; a titrated sample needs a new one from the lab.

coulometry.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} is titrating; the method cannot change now.
coulometry.configure:PRECONDITION_FAILED.fix: wait for it or stop it.

unsupported.titrant: a coulometric KF titrator generates its iodine at the generator electrode (no titrant to declare)
unsupported.connect: the cell and the electrodes are installed by the lab operator with the power off

alternatives.connect: ask the lab operator, or `chemlab call INST slot.set_installed --slot cell --installed true` with the power off.

method: current 100mA | 200mA | 400mA; drift-comp and start-drift in µg/min (e.g. 20ug/min); stir is the level (-15..15) used during the determination
stir: the manual stirrer takes levels: `stir on --level 8`, `stir off`
sample: the sample mass turns the titrated water into a water fraction

metrohm_899.manual: 899 Coulometer manual (KF principle and drift p.38-44, operation and methods p.45-71)

examples.method: chemlab run INST method current=400mA drift-comp=0ug/min hold=1s

titrant.label: no analysis running
titrant.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it.

method.label: no analysis running
method.message: {inst} is running an analysis; the method cannot change now.
method.fix: wait for it (`chemlab run {inst} wait`) or stop it.

start.label: power on
start.message: {inst} is switched off.
start.fix: switch it on: `chemlab run {inst} power on`.

start.label: method set
start.message: {inst} has no method.
start.fix: set one: `chemlab run {inst} method base=70mL boric=30mL` (see `chemlab help {inst} method`).

start.label: a digested sample tube
start.message: there is no digested sample tube in {inst}.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to put the digested tube in.

start.label: door shut
start.message: the safety door of {inst} is open (or still closing).
start.fix: close it: `chemlab run {inst} close door`, then give it a few seconds.

start.label: door closed
start.message: the safety door of {inst} is still moving shut.
start.fix: wait a few seconds (`chemlab wait 10`), then start.

start.label: tube clamped
start.message: the sample tube of {inst} is not clamped.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to clamp the tube (the lever is reached through the open door).

start.label: cooling water
start.message: {inst} has no valid cooling water flow.
start.fix: ask the lab operator to open the cooling water.

start.label: not cooling down
start.message: {inst} is still cooling down after the last analysis.
start.fix: wait a few minutes (`chemlab run {inst} status`).

start.label: idle
start.message: {inst} is not idle (the last analysis is over but its tube is still in place, or one is running).
start.fix: the lab operator drains the residue and puts the next tube in; see `chemlab run {inst} status`.

stop.label: an analysis running
stop.fix: nothing to stop; see `chemlab run {inst} status`.

acquisition.start:CAPACITY_LIMIT.message: the method needs more liquid than {inst} has (tube volume over 250 mL, or a reagent tank too low), or the base / boric acid cannot hold the sample's acid or nitrogen.
acquisition.start:CAPACITY_LIMIT.fix: lower water / base volumes in the method, or ask the lab operator to refill the tanks.

acquisition.start:PRECONDITION_FAILED.message: {inst} is not ready to start (door, tube clamp, cooling water, sample tube or the last analysis).

unsupported.sample: the sample is the digested tube; its mass is part of the lab's sample record, not a setting
unsupported.stir: no stirrer (the receiver is mixed by the distillate)
unsupported.connect: no electrode or cell slots (colorimetric end point)

titrant: the titrant concentration is a field of the method; the other method settings are kept
method: method.configure needs every setting; the ones you leave out stay as in the last accepted method, else the documented defaults (the reply lists them); steam takes a percentage (steam=80%)

velp_udk159.manual: UDK 159 leaflet p.1-2 (operation, technical data); UDK series brochure rev.3 p.4-5

examples.method: chemlab run INST method base=70mL boric=30mL steam=100%
